description.value: A Cantonese-style restaurant on West 41st Avenue in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, specializing in clay pot rice (煲仔飯) and noodle combos. The menu is extensive, featuring dozens of rice pot variations with preserved meats, seafood, and vegetables alongside classic dishes like wonton noodle soup and dry-fried beef ho fun. Online ordering with 30-minute pickup is available directly through the website.
